hero.title: A curriculum designed for your child
hero.subtitle: From Nursery to Grade 5, our programmes blend academic rigour with creativity, critical thinking, and real-world skills — giving every student the foundation to thrive.

body.text: At Trium, we believe learning happens best when students are active participants — not passive recipients. Our inquiry-based approach encourages children to ask questions, make connections, and construct their own understanding of the world.

Every lesson is designed with purpose: to build knowledge, develop skills, and nurture the dispositions that make a lifelong learner. We balance structured academic content with open-ended exploration, ensuring students are both prepared for assessments and genuinely excited about learning.

pillars.title: Inquiry-based learning
pillars.description: Students explore concepts through questions, investigation, and reflection rather than rote memorisation.

pillars.title: Differentiated instruction
pillars.description: Teachers adapt their approach to meet each student where they are, ensuring no child is left behind or unchallenged.

pillars.title: Integrated curriculum
pillars.description: Subjects are connected meaningfully — a science unit might incorporate maths, writing, and art — reflecting how the real world works.

pillars.title: Assessment for learning
pillars.description: We use ongoing, formative assessment to guide teaching and give students actionable feedback, not just grades.

programmes.name: Early Years
programmes.description: A play-based, nurturing environment that builds foundational literacy, numeracy, and social skills through exploration and structured play.

programmes.name: Primary School
programmes.description: At Trium we follow a progressive CBSE curriculum aligned to NEP. A rigorous yet joyful programme that builds strong academic foundations across all subjects while developing critical thinking and collaboration skills.

programmes.name: Secondary School
programmes.description: At Trium we follow a progressive CBSE curriculum aligned to NEP. A rigorous, balanced curriculum that connects disciplines and sparks bold thinking — building the skills, resilience, and self-awareness students carry into senior school.

highlights.text: Sports, arts, and design thinking projects that develop creativity and collaboration

cocurricular.heading: Co-curricular & beyond the classroom
cocurricular.subheading: We believe education extends far beyond textbooks. Our co-curricular programme is designed to discover and develop every student's unique talents.

areas.title: Sports & physical education
areas.description: Cricket, football, athletics, yoga, and more — building fitness, teamwork, and resilience.

areas.title: Performing arts
areas.description: Drama, music, and dance programmes that build confidence, expression, and creativity.

areas.title: Visual arts & craft
areas.description: Painting, sculpture, and design projects that develop aesthetic sensibility and fine motor skills.

areas.title: STEM & robotics
areas.description: Coding, robotics, and maker projects that develop computational thinking and problem-solving.

areas.title: Community service
areas.description: Age-appropriate service learning projects that build empathy and a sense of civic responsibility.

areas.title: Clubs & interest groups
areas.description: From debate to nature walks, students explore passions and develop leadership skills in a supportive setting.

cta.heading: See our curriculum in action
cta.subheading: Schedule a campus visit to meet our faculty and see how we bring learning to life every day.
